notes:
REF-BM-03: Auto-collected fields can be edited after saving, but there is no pre-save metadata editing flow.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and notes are editable, but the bookmark URL is not.
REF-BM-08: Selecting a card opens the edit panel; reaching the original URL requires a second click on its link.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and persisted, but Markdown is not rendered.
REF-BM-24: PDFs are preserved correctly, but webpages are stored as MHTML rather than local HTML.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves titles and tags but ignores ADD_DATE.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
